narration: A camera casts a ray into the 3D scene to sample a query point p on an object surface.
Query point p extracts features from multi-resolution grids, and an MLP predicts signed distance functions for each object.
The scene signed distance function is obtained by taking the minimum over all object SDFs, determining scene transmittance.
Object densities are modulated by scene transmittance to produce occlusion-aware opacities, supervised by 2D instance masks.
Geometric regularization enforces the Eikonal gradient constraint on SDFs and prevents interpenetration between objects.
Finally, volume rendering synthesizes depth, surface normals, and RGB appearance, jointly optimized with multi-modal supervision.
